telegram_service.description: TelegramService is a lightweight snapshot for the admin dashboard (no outbound Telegram calls).

card_number.description: Optional overrides; empty strings fall back to Telegram settings card_number/card_holder.

support_username.description: SupportUsername must be a Telegram handle without @ (5–32 chars, a–z 0–9 _).

cgroup.description: Linux control group to assign the VPN worker process to. Format: 'controller,subsystem:name'. Example: 'cpuset,cpu:test'

deny-roaming.description: Disconnect client if its IP changes (e.g., due to network switch). Example: true

dns.description: Comma-separated list of DNS servers to assign to the client. Example: '8.8.8.8,1.1.1.1'

dpd.description: Dead Peer Detection timeout in seconds. Example: 90

explicit-ipv4.description: Static IPv4 address to assign to client. Example: '192.168.100.10'

idle-timeout.description: Time in seconds before disconnecting idle clients. Example: 600

ipv4-network.description: The pool of addresses that leases will be given from. Example: '192.168.1.0/24'

iroute.description: Internal route available only via VPN. Format: 'IP/prefix'. Example: '10.0.0.0/8'

keepalive.description: Interval in seconds to send keep-alive pings. Example: 60

max-same-clients.description: Maximum simultaneous logins per user. Example: 2

mobile-dpd.description: DPD timeout specifically for mobile clients. Example: 300

mobile-idle-timeout.description: Idle timeout for mobile clients. Example: 900

mtu.description: Tunnel interface MTU to avoid fragmentation. Example: 1400

nbns.description: NetBIOS Name Servers (WINS) for Windows clients. Example: '192.168.1.1'

net-priority.description: Priority for routes; lower is higher priority. Example: 1

no-route.description: List of networks to exclude from VPN routing. Each entry should be in 'IP/prefix' format. Example: ['192.168.0.0/16', '10.0.0.0/8']

no-udp.description: Disables UDP, enforcing TCP-only VPN connection. Example: true

restrict-user-to-ports.description: Comma-separated list of allowed (or blocked, if negated) protocols and ports. Supports 'tcp(port)', 'udp(port)', 'icmp()', 'icmpv6()', and negation with '!()'. Example: 'tcp(443), tcp(80), udp(53)', or '!(tcp(22), udp(1194))'

restrict-user-to-routes.description: Allow client access only to defined routes. Example: true

route.description: Routes pushed to the client for routing traffic. Example: ['0.0.0.0/0', '10.10.0.0/16']

rx-data-per-sec.description: Maximum receive bandwidth in bytes per second. Example: '100000' for 100 KB/s

session-timeout.description: Max session time in seconds before forced disconnect. Example: 3600

split-dns.description: List of domains over which the provided DNS servers should be used. Example: ['example.com', 'internal.company.com']

stats-report-time.description: Interval in seconds for stats reporting. Example: 300

tunnel-all-dns.description: Force all DNS traffic through the VPN tunnel. Example: true

tx-data-per-sec.description: Maximum transmit bandwidth in bytes per second. Example: '200000' for 200 KB/s

total_rx.description: Aggregated current received traffic in bytes.

total_tx.description: Aggregated current transmitted traffic in bytes.

expire_at.description:
ExpireAt is the effective expiry instant. It remains nil for a
first-connection account until the worker observes its first session.

running_rx.description: Current received bytes since the last usage reset

running_tx.description: Current transmitted bytes since the last usage reset

dns.description: Comma-separated list of DNS servers to assign to the user. Example: '8.8.8.8,1.1.1.1'

explicit-ipv4.description: Static IPv4 address to assign to the user. Example: '192.168.100.10'

idle-timeout.description: Time in seconds before disconnecting idle users. Example: 600

ipv4-network.description: The pool of addresses from which to assign to the user. Example: '192.168.1.0/24'

iroute.description: Internal route available only via VPN. Example: '10.0.0.0/8'

mobile-idle-timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds for mobile users. Example: 900

nbns.description: NetBIOS Name Servers (WINS) for Windows clients. Example: '192.168.1.1'

no-route.description: List of networks to exclude from VPN routing. Example: ['192.168.0.0/16', '10.0.0.0/8']

rekey-time.description: Rekey time in seconds; triggers key renegotiation. Example: 86400 for 24 hours

restrict-to-ports.description: Comma-separated list of allowed or blocked ports/protocols. Supports 'tcp(port)', 'udp(port)', 'icmp()', 'icmpv6()', and negation with '!()'. Example: 'tcp(443), udp(53)' or '!(tcp(22), udp(1194))'

restrict-to-routes.description: Allow user access only to defined routes. Example: true

route.description: Routes pushed to the user for routing traffic. Example: ['0.0.0.0/0', '10.10.0.0/16']

session-timeout.description: Maximum session time in seconds before forced disconnect. Example: 3600

split-dns.description: List of domains over which the provided DNS servers should be used. Example: ['example.com', 'internal.company.com']

awaiting_payment_message_id.description:
AwaitingPaymentMessageID is the Telegram message_id of the bot message sent when
the request moved to awaiting_payment (may contain card details). Used to delete
that message if the request is later rejected.
